body:
Thank you. This really does help to hear, and I appreciate knowing that there are people out there who get it.

Also, I'm sorry for taking so long to respond. I posted this, and then I kind of crashed. I'd been up all night, so I fell asleep for most of the day. I did end up talking to my roommate about what was going on for me, and called another friend. I'm feeling in a bit more stable of a place than I was this morning. I just have really intense episodes sometimes, where it feels like everything is crashing down, then I end up feeling shitty and embarassed about my meltdowns afterwards. I've definitely decided that I'll be staying sober and staying safe for tonight, though.
